stations.note: One hose at a time in a dry spell.

stations.title: Rhiannon's watch
stations.text: She shouts each turn, and loses track.

stations.title: The main tap
stations.text: One plot at a time, in rota order.

captions: At Marrowfield, Rhiannon wants the laptop to call each plot's turn at the tap.
Today she shouts the turns by her watch, and when it rains nobody knows who was next.
You write a rota that runs on a timer and stops cleanly when asked, in three tasks.
Now the turns come by themselves, and stopping says who goes first next time.
Same rainy day, same tap. Nobody loses a turn, and the script ends tidily.
